mapper.select: /* Tbm01Mapper.selectTbmEduItemInfo */ SELECT '' AS chk , A.MTRL_ITEM_CD AS mtrlItemCd , A.MTRL_CD AS mtrlCd , A.SORT_IDX AS sortIdx , A.MTRL_ITEM_TYPE AS mtrlItemType , A.MTRL_DESC AS mtrlDesc , A.FILE_MGMT_CD AS fileMgmtCd , B.FILE_NM AS fileNm , B.FILE_PATH AS filePath , B.FILE_EXT AS fileExt , A.URL AS url , A.USE_YN AS useYn /* 데이터 초기화 값 */ , A.SORT_IDX AS oriSortIdx , A.MTRL_ITEM_TYPE AS oriMtrlItemType , A.MTRL_DESC AS oriMtrlDesc , A.FILE_MGMT_CD AS oriFileMgmtCd , B.FILE_NM AS oriFileNm , B.FILE_PATH AS oriFilePath , B.FILE_EXT AS oriFileExt , A.URL AS oriUrl , A.USE_YN AS oriUseYn FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL_ITEM A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_FILE_INFO B ON ( A.FILE_MGMT_CD = B.FILE_MGMT_CD ) WHERE A.MTRL_CD = #{mtrlCd}
